title: Slate Interactions v2
description: What the device sends when the user taps. One batch per flush; seq is the idempotency key.

seq.description: Client-generated unique id (e.g. uuid). Server dedupes on it. Never reuse after a 2xx.

elementId.description: The question id (answer/text) or todoList id (check/uncheck) that was tapped.

questionId.description: answer/text only: the question element id.

optionId.description: answer only: the chosen option id.

optionLabel.description: answer only: convenience echo of the option label so the agent needs no lookup.

itemId.description: check/uncheck only: the todo item id.

value.description: text only: the free-text string the user typed.

clientAt.description: When the tap happened on-device (may predate server receipt if queued offline).
